## How it works

- **Key and spelling.** Every note takes its letter from the scale's own degrees, so G♯ harmonic minor has its F𝄪 and the
  blues scale has both the ♭5 and the 5. The key signature is the scale's mode on the tonic (Dorian on D: no sharps or flats);
  harmonic and melodic minor use the natural minor's, as printed scale books do. Enharmonic keys (F♯ / G♭) are spelled with
  the fewer accidentals, and for a transposing instrument with the fewer in the key you read.
- **Transposing instruments** read written pitch (B♭ instruments a step up, E♭ alto a sixth up, horn in F a fifth up, guitar
  and bass an octave up); playback sounds at concert pitch.
- **Patterns** move up the scale one step at a time, then down. "Mirror" turns the figure upside down on the way down
  (Hanon's way); off, the same shape moves down (the jazz way, so an enclosure still lands on its target from both sides).
- **Swing** is written as straight eighths; the playback swings them, and with the band the band's own swing feel plays.
- **Hanon.** Nos. 1–20 (*The Virtuoso Pianist*, Part I) are played note for note, with Hanon's fingering, from the Mutopia
  Project's edition (after Schirmer, 1900), read by a script. They keep Hanon's two octaves; on another scale the same degrees are
  used, and on a scale that isn't seven notes the figure changes shape.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var SP = window.ScalePatterns, $ = function (id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var KEYS = ["C", "D♭ / C♯", "D", "E♭ / D♯", "E", "F", "F♯ / G♭", "G", "A♭ / G♯", "A", "B♭ / A♯", "B"];
  function fill(sel, list, grouped) {
    var groups = {};
    list.forEach(function (x) {
      var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = x.id; o.textContent = x.label;
      if (grouped && x.group) { if (!groups[x.group]) { groups[x.group] = document.createElement("optgroup"); groups[x.group].label = x.group; sel.appendChild(groups[x.group]); } groups[x.group].appendChild(o); }
      else sel.appendChild(o);
    });
  }
  KEYS.forEach(function (k, i) { var o = document.createElement("option"); o.value = i; o.textContent = k; $("sp-tonic").appendChild(o); });
  fill($("sp-scale"), SP.SCALES, true); fill($("sp-pattern"), SP.PATTERNS, true); fill($("sp-style"), SP.STYLES); fill($("sp-inst"), SP.INSTRUMENTS);
  var SOUND = { piano: "piano", guitar: "clguitar", bass: "ebass" };

  // settings <-> the address, so a link is the exercise
  var FIELDS = { k: "sp-tonic", sc: "sp-scale", p: "sp-pattern", st: "sp-style", m: "sp-meter", u: "sp-unit", i: "sp-inst", h: "sp-hand",
    o: "sp-oct", d: "sp-dir", r: "sp-rhythm", a: "sp-artic", sh: "sp-shift", q: "sp-qpm", snd: "sp-sound" };
  var CHECKS = { alt: "sp-alt", mir: "sp-mirror", lab: "sp-labels", ch: "sp-chords", band: "sp-band" };
  var q = new URLSearchParams(location.search), mirrorTouched = q.has("mir"), altTouched = q.has("alt");
  Object.keys(FIELDS).forEach(function (k) { if (q.has(k)) $(FIELDS[k]).value = q.get(k); });
  Object.keys(CHECKS).forEach(function (k) { if (q.has(k)) $(CHECKS[k]).checked = q.get(k) === "1"; });
  function save() {
    var p = new URLSearchParams();
    Object.keys(FIELDS).forEach(function (k) { p.set(k, $(FIELDS[k]).value); });
    Object.keys(CHECKS).forEach(function (k) { p.set(k, $(CHECKS[k]).checked ? "1" : "0"); });
    history.replaceState(null, "", location.pathname + "?" + p.toString() + location.hash);
  }
  function patDefaults() {
    var p = SP.PATTERNS.find(function (x) { return x.id === $("sp-pattern").value; });
    if (!mirrorTouched) $("sp-mirror").checked = !!p.mirror;
    if (!altTouched) $("sp-alt").checked = !!p.alternate;
  }
  function styleDefaults() {
    var s = SP.STYLES.find(function (x) { return x.id === $("sp-style").value; });
    $("sp-qpm").value = s.qpm; $("sp-qpm-v").textContent = s.qpm;
  }

  var cur = null, visual = null;
  function opts(chords) {
    return { tonic: +$("sp-tonic").value, scale: $("sp-scale").value, pattern: $("sp-pattern").value, style: $("sp-style").value,
      meter: $("sp-meter").value, unit: $("sp-unit").value, inst: $("sp-inst").value, hand: $("sp-hand").value, octaves: +$("sp-oct").value,
      dir: $("sp-dir").value, rhythm: $("sp-rhythm").value, artic: $("sp-artic").value || null, octaveShift: +$("sp-shift").value,
      alternate: $("sp-alt").checked, mirror: $("sp-mirror").checked, labels: $("sp-labels").checked, chords: chords, qpm: +$("sp-qpm").value };
  }
  function list(el, items) { el.innerHTML = ""; items.forEach(function (t) { var li = document.createElement("li"); li.textContent = t; el.appendChild(li); }); }
  function render() {
    stop();
    $("sp-hand-w").style.display = $("sp-inst").value === "piano" ? "" : "none";
    cur = SP.make(opts($("sp-chords").checked));
    $("sp-abc").textContent = cur.abc;
    visual = ABCJS.renderAbc("sp-score", cur.abc, { responsive: "resize", add_classes: true, staffwidth: 900, wrap: { minSpacing: 1.6, maxSpacing: 2.6, preferredMeasuresPerLine: 4 } })[0];
    list($("sp-tips"), cur.tips); list($("sp-inst-tips"), cur.instTips.length ? cur.instTips : ["Nothing in this exercise needs special care on this instrument."]);
    $("sp-warn").textContent = cur.warnings.join(" ");
    save();
  }

  var handle = null;
  function stop() { if (handle) { try { handle.stop(); } catch (e) {} handle = null; } $("sp-play").textContent = "▶ Play"; }
  $("sp-play").addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (handle) return stop();
    var band = $("sp-band").checked && cur.band, qpm = +$("sp-qpm").value, done = function () { handle = null; $("sp-play").textContent = "▶ Play"; };
    var common = { sound: $("sp-sound").value, qpm: qpm, transpose: -cur.semi, onEnd: done };
    if (band) {
      // the band reads chord symbols: play a version that has them, drawn off the page
      var withCh = SP.make(opts(true)), div = document.createElement("div"); div.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:-9999px;width:900px";
      document.body.appendChild(div);
      var v = ABCJS.renderAbc(div, withCh.abc)[0];
      handle = AbcPlay.play(v, Object.assign({ abc: withCh.abc, style: cur.band, light: false }, common));
      handle.done && handle.done.then(function () { div.remove(); });
    } else if (cur.swing) {
      var d2 = document.createElement("div"); d2.style.cssText = "position:absolute;left:-9999px;width:900px"; document.body.appendChild(d2);
      var v2 = ABCJS.renderAbc(d2, cur.playAbc)[0];
      handle = AbcPlay.play(v2, Object.assign({ light: false }, common));
      handle.done && handle.done.then(function () { d2.remove(); });
    } else handle = AbcPlay.play(visual, common);
    $("sp-play").textContent = "■ Stop";
  });
  $("sp-qpm").addEventListener("input", function () { $("sp-qpm-v").textContent = this.value; });
  $("sp-qpm").addEventListener("change", render);
  $("sp-pattern").addEventListener("change", function () { mirrorTouched = altTouched = false; patDefaults(); render(); });
  $("sp-style").addEventListener("change", function () { styleDefaults(); render(); });
  $("sp-inst").addEventListener("change", function () { $("sp-sound").value = SOUND[$("sp-inst").value] || "piano"; render(); });
  $("sp-mirror").addEventListener("change", function () { mirrorTouched = true; render(); });
  $("sp-alt").addEventListener("change", function () { altTouched = true; render(); });
  ["sp-tonic", "sp-scale", "sp-meter", "sp-unit", "sp-hand", "sp-oct", "sp-dir", "sp-rhythm", "sp-artic", "sp-shift", "sp-labels", "sp-chords", "sp-band", "sp-sound"]
    .forEach(function (id) { $(id).addEventListener("change", render); });
  $("sp-next").addEventListener("click", function () { $("sp-tonic").value = (+$("sp-tonic").value + 5) % 12; render(); });
  $("sp-copy").addEventListener("click", function () { try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(location.href); this.textContent = "Copied"; var b = this; setTimeout(function () { b.textContent = "Copy link"; }, 1200); } catch (e) {} });
  $("sp-print").addEventListener("click", function () { window.print(); });
  if (!q.has("p")) patDefaults();
  if (!q.has("q")) styleDefaults();
  render();
})();
</script>
```
